g.text: Full map: 142 of 1,001 ambient coefficient rows are identically zero. Rebuilt map: 782 are zero; both use the exact active rows.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17323b

g.text: Twenty row functionals isolate the off-diagonal squares. Twelve more eliminate correction variables; five cubic identities finish the proof.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53666d

g.text: An initial helper rejected five valid Z·x quotient multipliers; the corrected monic recurrence retains and checks all 75 directions.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ca584c

g.text: Sparsity and rank alone are not the exclusion proof. Exact identities are independently checked, with full numerator freedom in this family.
